correctness.rationale: The exact finite-state resource mortality and strategy rates define a killed generator. The pure-cooperator Perron eigenvector is strictly increasing by skip-free stochastic order plus its eigen-equation. All other strategy blocks have strictly smaller spectral abscissa via an irreducible Metzler supervector comparison, and positive paths reach all-cooperator states exactly when Rc>1. For Rc<=1 no cooperator gain occurs with positive resource. Uniform finite-state death paths guarantee extinction. The finite checker passed 90 parameter families, while the proof covers all admissible finite parameters.

value.rationale: The first unit of resource is a natural, non-arbitrary threshold because the biological feedback gate is based on resource scarcity in integer resource units. The theorem turns mere accessibility into a global spectral survival-selection statement, sharply separates two long-time conditional regimes and explains why a finite-horizon quasi-cycle does not define a stationary ecosystem. No future downstream theorem is assumed; the sharp exact classification of the initiating ecological Markov chain is intrinsically informative.
